scope: Support only; no real stage adoption, deployment, private write or commit by subagent.

sameSongFallback.reason: Bounded reviewed search did not find the full corresponding version.

evidence.note: Evidence establishing the same song, group participation and actual source scope.

rules: Normalization keeps versionMatch false and generates visible same-song/excerpt/alternate-version labels.
Complete corresponding originals rank before existing guest-scope member fallback, then same-song fallback.
Merger accepts same-song fallback only for locally empty and published-empty slots with owner empty score and complete journal, using the original freshness checks.
Existing sources cannot be replaced by a same-song fallback. Later exact/full replacement still uses unchanged score/log/preimage/occasion safeguards.
Original performer scope must remain matched; concerts/events remain excluded.
Bilibili exact BV/CID/page and existing source keys are unchanged.
Optional sourceWorkId permits reuse only of an exact already-bound same-group source, with performedSong matching that source work; no saved score is copied.
Anonymous projection exposes declared differences but strips raw evidence and research reason.

validation.fullBuild: not run by subagent; root will run once

currentPreparedCandidates.guard: requires genuine fresh owner empty score, complete journal and exact published preimage
